headline: Advance Timed Entry for Alamo Church
reservation: Admission to The Alamo is free, but a timed entry reservation is required to enter the historic Church. For those planning to stay in the Hill Country, glamping sites and state natural areas like Enchanted Rock require separate advance bookings through the Texas Parks and Wildlife system; check official portals for current bottleneck updates.

days.title: Historic Missions and River Walks

stops.name: The Alamo
stops.detail: Visit the Long Barrack and Church to learn about the 1836 siege that defined Texas history.

stops.name: San Antonio Missions National Historical Park
stops.detail: Explore Mission San José to see the ornate Rose Window and the beautifully preserved colonial architecture.

days.driving: Allow 30-45 minutes to transit between downtown and the southern missions; conditions vary
days.note: Start early to beat the Texas heat, especially when walking the unshaded grounds of the missions.

days.title: Cultural Hubs and Urban Gardens
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Japanese Tea Garden

stops.name: Japanese Tea Garden
stops.detail: Walk through lush floral displays and stone bridges set within a reclaimed limestone quarry.

stops.name: Pearl District
stops.detail: Browse the former brewery complex turned cultural hub, featuring independent shops and a scenic riverwalk extension.

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes for transfers within the Brackenridge Park and Pearl areas
days.note: The Pearl Farmers Market occurs on weekends and can significantly increase local traffic.

days.title: Hill Country Transitions
days.start: Suggested: 8:30 AM from downtown San Antonio

stops.name: Natural Bridge Caverns
stops.detail: Descend into limestone rooms to view ancient stalactites and complex geological formations.

stops.name: Cibolo Center for Conservation
stops.detail: Visit the gateway city of Boerne to hike trails through distinct Texas habitats including marshland and woods.

days.driving: Allow 60-90 minutes for a round trip into the Hill Country; conditions vary
days.note: Roads in the Hill Country can be narrow and winding; allow extra time for rural navigation.

intel.title: Downtown Garage Strategy
intel.text: City-run garages are typically more affordable than private lots near the River Walk. Check for hotel parking packages if staying in the historic core to avoid daily fees.

intel.title: Missions Trail Coverage
intel.text: Cellular reception is reliable along the Mission Reach trail. Some remote areas of Government Canyon State Natural Area may have intermittent coverage.

intel.title: Hill Country Supply
intel.text: Gas stations are plentiful in Boerne and New Braunfels. Ensure you fuel up before heading into the more rural sections of the Balcones Escarpment.

intel.title: Summer Heat Precautions
intel.text: Temperatures regularly exceed 90 degrees in summer. Aim for indoor museums like the Witte or San Antonio Museum of Art during mid-afternoon.

intel.title: River Walk Navigation
intel.text: Portions of the River Walk involve stairs; look for designated elevator access points if traveling with strollers or mobility aids.

plan.arrival: Upon arrival at SAT, collect your rental and drive 20 minutes to downtown. Check-in and head to the River Walk for an initial orientation stroll.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are ideal for the city; if heading to Enchanted Rock or rugged Hill Country ranches, check rental terms for gravel road use.
plan.goldenHour: Tower of the Americas offers a panoramic sunset view, though local humidity can affect long-range visibility.
